name: Cuneiform
sampleText: To know the past is to plant the seeds of the future.
lossImpact: If we couldn't read this, 3,000 years of history—laws, recipes, and stories like Gilgamesh—would be silent forever.

name: Hieroglyphics
sampleText: The river brings life to the desert and strength to the people.
lossImpact: We would see the pyramids as just piles of stone, not the gateways to eternity they were meant to be.
